info.title: Better Stack Telemetry Universal API
info.description: Manage telemetry sources, source groups, metrics, dashboards, and connections.

post.description: Creates a new exploration alert in Better Stack Telemetry.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

explorationId.description: The ID of the exploration to add the alert to.

operator.description: Comparison operator for threshold and relative alerts.

value.description: Numeric value for the alert condition.

stringValue.description: Exact string match value for threshold alerts.

queryPeriod.description: Time window in seconds for analyzed data.

confirmationPeriod.description: Seconds the condition must hold before alerting.

recoveryPeriod.description: Seconds the condition must be resolved before recovery.

checkPeriod.description: How often to evaluate threshold and relative alerts.

seriesNames[].description: Series names to scope the alert to.

sourceVariable.description: Source variable used for source selection.

incidentPerSeries.description: Create a separate incident for each triggering series.

paused.description: Create the alert in a paused state.

teamName.description: Team name for global API tokens.

post.description: Creates a new metric in Better Stack Telemetry.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

sourceId.description: Source for which to create a metric

sqlExpression.description: SQL expression to use for the metric

teamName.description: Required if using a global API token to specify the team that should own the metric

aggregations[].description: Aggregations to apply to the metric

post.description: Creates a new telemetry source in Better Stack Telemetry.

teamName.description: Required if using a global API token to specify the team that should own the source

sourceGroupId.description: Source group to attach the source to

liveTailPattern.description: Pattern used for live tail display

logsRetention.description: Data retention for logs in days

metricsRetention.description: Data retention for metrics in days

vrlTransformation.description: VRL transformation to apply to ingested data

scrapeUrls[].description: URLs to scrape for prometheus_scrape and similar platforms

scrapeRequestHeaders[].description: Request headers for scrape requests as an array of objects with name and value

customBucket.keepDataAfterRetention.description: Whether to keep data in the bucket after the retention period
